docs.title: VargaLABS
docs.text: VargaLABS builds SIGMA, software for systems engineering and data work, from Toronto, Canada.

docs.title: SIGMA IAM and the licence service
docs.text:
SIGMA software checks its licence with the VargaLABS licence service at api.vargalabs.com. The service issues signed licence tokens, offers signed software updates, and receives error reports when you allow them.

You can link an installation to your GitHub, Google or LinkedIn account, so that we can connect your installations to you and help you with your licence. We receive only your account ID, email address and display name, and never your password.

Read what we collect and how long we keep it in the Privacy Policy. The rules for using the service are in the Terms of Service.

docs.title: Privacy Policy
docs.text:
Last updated: October 19, 2026

This policy explains what information VargaLABS ("we") collects when you use SIGMA software and the SIGMA licence service at api.vargalabs.com, why we collect it, and how long we keep it.

Who we are: VargaLABS, a business operated by Steven Varga, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Contact for privacy questions: info@vargalabs.com.

docs.title: 1. Licence check-in
docs.text:
When SIGMA software checks its licence, it sends:

  • the installation key that identifies your licence;
  • a machine fingerprint: a one-way SHA-256 hash made on your computer. We cannot get your hardware details, computer name or user name back from it;
  • the product name and version.

We record when each machine was first and last seen. We use this to issue licence tokens, to enforce the number of machines your licence allows, and to offer software updates.

Kept: a machine record is deleted automatically 30 days after the machine was last seen. A record of a licence rule being broken (for example, too many machines) is deleted after 365 days.

docs.title: 2. Linking an installation to an account (optional)
docs.text:
If you choose to link an installation, you sign in with GitHub, Google or LinkedIn. That provider tells us:

  • your account ID at that provider;
  • your email address, if the provider gives one (for GitHub, only your verified primary email);
  • your display name.

We use this only to connect your installations to you, so that we can contact you about your licence. We use the provider's access to your account once, during sign-in, and we do not keep it. We never receive your password.

Kept: the short link session is deleted after 10 minutes. Your linked account record is kept while your licence is active, and is deleted on request.

docs.title: 3. Error reports (optional)
docs.text:
If SIGMA software reports an error, it sends the installation key, the product name and version, and the text of the error report. We remove links, mentions and hidden markup from the text, and file it as an issue in a private GitHub repository that only VargaLABS staff can read.

Kept: the report record on our servers is deleted after 30 days. The issue in the private repository is kept until the problem is fixed and the issue is closed or removed.

docs.title: 4. Payments
docs.text:
When you buy a licence, Stripe processes the payment. Stripe collects your card details and billing address under its own privacy policy. We receive the name, email address, country and amount of the purchase, and the last four digits of the card. We never receive the full card number.

Kept: payment records are kept as long as Canadian tax law requires, currently at least six years.

docs.title: 5. Server logs
docs.text: Our servers log the IP address, request path, status and response time of each request, to protect the service against abuse and to fix problems. Kept: 30 days.

docs.title: What we do not do
docs.text:
• We do not use cookies, advertising or tracking on the licence service.
  • We do not sell or rent your information.
  • We do not read your files, data or source code. The licence service receives only what is listed above.

docs.title: Who processes your information
docs.text:
Service What for Where Amazon Web Services runs the licence service and stores the records above United States (us-east-1) GitHub private repository for error reports; sign-in if you choose GitHub United States Google sign-in, if you choose Google United States LinkedIn sign-in, if you choose LinkedIn United States Stripe payments, if you buy a licence Canada and the United States

Your information may therefore be stored and processed outside your own country, including in the United States.

docs.title: Security
docs.text: Data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest. Signing keys and provider secrets are encrypted with AWS KMS. Access to the records is limited to VargaLABS administrators.

docs.title: Your rights
docs.text:
You can ask us to show, correct or delete the information we hold about you, or unlink an account, by writing to info@vargalabs.com. We answer within 30 days. Deleting the licence records of an active installation stops that installation from checking its licence.

If you are in Canada, you may also complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada. If you are in the European Union or the United Kingdom, you may complain to your local data protection authority.

docs.title: Children
docs.text: SIGMA is a professional tool. It is not meant for children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

docs.title: Changes
docs.text: If we change this policy, we update the date at the top. If a change matters, we also announce it in the software's update notice.

docs.title: Terms of Service
docs.text:
Last updated: October 19, 2026

These terms apply to the SIGMA licence service at api.vargalabs.com and to linking an installation to an account. The SIGMA software itself is covered by its licence agreement, which you accept when you install it.

Provider: VargaLABS, a business operated by Steven Varga, Toronto, Ontario, Canada ("VargaLABS", "we"). Contact: info@vargalabs.com.

docs.title: 1. Use of the service
docs.text:
The licence service checks licences, issues licence tokens, offers updates, links installations to accounts and receives error reports. You may use it only through SIGMA software, or as our documentation describes.

You must not:

  • share, sell or publish your installation key, or use it on more machines than your licence allows;
  • try to get around licence checks, or forge licence tokens or update notices;
  • send requests faster than the software normally does, or try to overload, probe or break into the service;
  • send error reports that contain other people's personal information or content you are not allowed to share.

docs.title: 2. Accounts
docs.text: When you link an installation, you sign in with a third-party account (GitHub, Google or LinkedIn). That provider's own terms also apply. You are responsible for the installations you link and for keeping your account secure.

docs.title: 3. Availability
docs.text: We aim to keep the service available, but we do not promise that it will always be available or free of errors. SIGMA software continues to work for a limited time when it cannot reach the service, as described in its documentation.

docs.title: 4. Suspension
docs.text: We may suspend or revoke a licence or an account link if these terms are broken, if a licence expires or is not paid, or if we must do so by law. Where it is reasonable, we tell you first.

docs.title: 5. Updates
docs.text: The service may tell SIGMA software that an update is available. Updates are signed by VargaLABS. Installing an update is your choice unless your licence agreement says otherwise.

docs.title: 6. Disclaimer
docs.text: The service is provided "as is". To the extent the law allows, we give no warranty that it is fit for a particular purpose.

docs.title: 7. Limitation of liability
docs.text: To the extent the law allows, our total liability arising from the service is limited to the amount you paid for your licence in the 12 months before the claim. We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profits or lost data.

docs.title: 8. Privacy
docs.text: Our Privacy Policy explains what information the service collects and how we use it.

docs.title: 9. Changes
docs.text: We may change these terms. We update the date at the top, and announce important changes in the software's update notice. If you keep using the service after a change, the new terms apply.

docs.title: 10. Law
docs.text: These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada that apply there.
